description: Write /docs/evaluation-report.md and /docs/test-report.md, then update /docs/traceability.md and /docs/known-issues.md based on evaluation results. Depends on FEAT-001 (evaluation scripts must have been run so evaluation/results/ is populated) and FEAT-002 (pytest tests must have been run). Every number in the report must come from evaluation/results/ files — never from memory.
steps: Read all JSON and CSV files in /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/results/ to collect actual measured numbers.

Write /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/docs/evaluation-report.md with these sections: (1) Purpose and method, (2) Dataset and ground-truth design (RANDOM_SEED=42, NUM_PRODUCTS=50, NUM_CUSTOMERS=1000, category elasticity anchors from data_generation/config.py, segment true weights), (3) Forecasting evaluation with MAE/RMSE/MAPE table for both models, category breakdown table, distribution stats, MAPE/zero-actual analysis, leakage check result, figures referenced as ../evaluation/results/forecasting_*.png, (4) Segmentation evaluation with ARI/NMI/purity table, confusion matrix, RFM profile table, stability results, figures, (5) Elasticity evaluation with MAE/RMSE/Pearson/Spearman/sign-agreement table, category breakdown, worst estimates table, scatter figure, (6) Pricing evaluation with constraint compliance (expected 0 violations), direction distribution, elasticity-direction correlation, determinism result, optional GT revenue simulation if run, (7) LLM layer evaluation with failure handling results, guardrail stored pass rate, prompt validation results, (8) System performance with training times, API response times table (median+95th pct per endpoint), hardware info, parameter values table, (9) Headline results summary table (one row per REQ group: REQ-7-11 forecasting, REQ-12-15 segmentation, REQ-16 elasticity, REQ-17-19 pricing, REQ-20-22 LLM, key metric and PASS/FAIL), (10) Limitations and threats to validity.

Write /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/docs/test-report.md with: (1) Test inventory table (columns: file, scope, test_count, framework, command), (2) Gaps filled in Phase 13 (list the 6 new test files with what each covers), (3) Remaining gaps (any gaps not addressed), (4) How to run all tests (exact commands per suite).

Update /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/docs/traceability.md: for REQ-7 to REQ-22, add measured values in the Verification column using numbers from evaluation/results/ files. Update the summary counts if any REQ status changes.

Update /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/docs/known-issues.md: (a) close or reference KI-01 (TIE_TOLERANCE) based on the test_phase13_api_contract.py result; (b) add any new KI found during evaluation (e.g., MAPE distortion from zero actuals if significant, any elasticity sign failures, any constraint violations). Do NOT remove any existing KI that is still valid.
